education.institute: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, Delhi

workExperience.title: Analyst - Data Science
bullets: Consulted for a telecom client to architect a Next-Best-Offer (NBO) propensity model using **XGBoost** and **Logistic Regression**, shifting from rule-based targeting to predictive cross-selling and improving **conversion recall by 18%**.

Extracted and engineered **40+ behavioral and usage features** from **2M+ raw SQL billing records**, establishing a Python automated pipeline to monitor **Population Stability Index (PSI)** and prevent **data drift** in production.

Deployed the optimization engine as a **Flask microservice** directly into the client's CRM, automating real-time personalized product recommendations for **50,000 daily touchpoints** and driving an estimated **8% uplift in Average Revenue Per User (ARPU)**.

workExperience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Analyzed sales and user engagement data to identify top-performing events and **customer segments**.
Built interactive dashboards in **Power BI** tracking KPIs like repeat purchase rate, average order value, and regional trends, improving reporting **efficiency by 40%**.
Identified that **22% of high-value customers dropped off** after their first purchase; performed **cohort analysis** and recommended targeted campaigns that **increased repeat purchases by 12%**.
Automated weekly sales summary reports using Python (**Pandas + Matplotlib**), reducing manual reporting time from **4 hours to 30 minutes**.

projects.name: Ai based Energy Cost Optimisation
bullets: Predicted 10-minute household energy consumption across **19,000+ records** using weather and time data, achieving an average **prediction error of just 34 Watt-hours**.
Identified **215 abnormal energy events (1% of the test data)** by calculating the difference between expected and actual power usage to flag unexplained equipment spikes.
Wrote a scheduling script to shift **30% of flexible daily appliance usage** away from expensive peak-pricing hours, proving a **6.46% reduction in total electricity costs**.

projects.name: Landscape Classification
bullets: Engineered a custom **6-class landscape image classifier** in TensorFlow, designing a multi-layer CNN coupled with a spatial and color **data augmentation pipeline** to extract invariant topological features.

Diagnosed semantic boundary failures (e.g., Glacier vs. Sea) via confusion matrix analysis, successfully identifying and mitigating model color bias by injecting targeted **RandomContrast** transformations.

Optimized spatial feature extraction by implementing custom **Convolutional Block Attention Modules (CBAM)**, allowing the network to dynamically suppress urban background noise and improve **accuracy to 0.86**.

projects.name: Graph Neural Network for Anti-Money Laundering
bullets: Designed and trained a **Temporal-Aware Heterogeneous GNN** using PyTorch Geometric to detect complex, multi-hop money laundering rings.
Engineered a relational graph topology from the IBM AML dataset (**7M+ transactions**), mapping discrete Bank and Account entities alongside sequential transaction timestamps.
Overcame extreme class imbalance (**0.05% laundering prevalence**) by implementing localized mini-batching (**Link Neighbor Loader**) and heavily weighted loss functions.
Outperformed traditional tabular baselines (like XGBoost), achieving a **PR-AUC of 0.68** and an **F1-score of 0.62** by successfully capturing topological transaction sequences.

research.title: Knowledge Distillation on Complex CNNs
bullets: Worked on a teacher–student distillation setup for image classification using a **ResNet-18 teacher** and two student models (real and complex-valued).
Designed and implemented a **magnitude–phase KL-divergence loss** for distilling complex-valued logits.
Used **IHSV transformation** to train the complex student on complex-valued image inputs.
Evaluated performance on **CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet** datasets.
Reduced model size from **11.2M to 2.8M parameters (~75% smaller)** with minimal accuracy drop.
Complex student achieved **5–10% higher train and test accuracy** compared to the real-valued student.

research.title: An Empirical Study of Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models
bullets: Built a dataset of **game-theoretic scenarios** (Prisoner's Dilemma, Ultimatum Game) to test decision-making in LLMs.
Ran experiments across **open-source and API-based** language models.
Defined evaluation metrics such as **equilibrium accuracy, cooperation rate, and strategy consistency**.
Analyzed results using statistical methods to study trends across different **model sizes**.
Developed an **automated pipeline** for prompt generation, response collection, and scoring.
Documented findings with clear plots and technical reports.

research.title: Uniform Laws of Large Numbers for Set-Valued Mappings and Subdifferentials of Random Functions
bullets: Presented and explained theoretical results on **uniform convergence in set-valued mappings**.
Discussed implications for **stochastic optimization** and **learning theory**.
